rationale_evidence.anchor: a FOURTH disjoint vocabulary — and the first at PRIMITIVE level
rationale_evidence.statement: New gap G-86: Chapter 13's 'Type System - Solved' section gives seven types (Field, KnowledgeAtma, KnowledgeAtmaSupreme, AppliedKnowledge, plus a partial KnowledgeState) against the ratified eight primitives (Entity, State, Event, Observation, Proposition, Relation, Policy, Action; C-022/step-049, '50 attack classes, no counterexample'); only Observation clearly overlaps (via Prakrti -> Evidence/Observation/Context). Four Gita-only types exist, two of which (K_atma, K_supreme) are RX (refuted). A seven-type ontology missing Action, Policy, Event, Relation and Proposition cannot express admissibility, governance, transitions, or the assertion graph -- assessed as 'not a competing kernel; a different subject'.

rationale_evidence.anchor: the proposal adds three operation names not in any registry
rationale_evidence.statement: Audits S2219's 11 proposed kernel operations (Observe, Discriminate, ..., Contradict, Revise, Supersede, Remember, Forget/Withdraw, Act/Transform) against Step 291's 22-operation registry: Revise/Supersede/Withdraw/Transform are already registered (with 0 bodies/identity/ratification); Discriminate, Remember, Contradict (only Conflict exists as a Sigma axis) are NOT in the 22-operation registry; Qualify is already G1; Observe is a ratified primitive (Observation), not an operation. rationale_evidence.anchor: SIX disjoint operation vocabularies in the estate
rationale_evidence.statement: Counts six disjoint operation vocabularies now in the estate: (1) 272A's O_sem, 19 operations; (2) external_research pseudo-algorithm, 43 functions; (3) the corpus registry (256.2/259.7/261.19), 22 operations; (4) Ch13's type ontology, 7 (primitives not operations); (5) Omega_K={Discriminate,Qualify,Transition} + 11 named (artifact 20); (6, new, this batch) {E,R,C,X,Q,Z} from S2226 -- registered as G-91 (was three vocabularies at G-68, four at G-86, now six). Notes Qualify appears in both the fifth and sixth vocabularies (G-92): two independently constructed minimal-ish algebras both contain the one irreducible gap, reinforcing artifact 20's finding that any minimal kernel algebra containing Qualify inherits G1. Also notes both new sources ask about closure/associativity/non-commutativity, matching the corpus's own prior non-law (25J.46: 'we should not yet impose universal commutativity').
